headline: Energy bills could rise considerably, and price increases will spread down the chain: authorities are looking for money for compensation and asking people to save
summary: Moldovans' energy bills will rise considerably this winter amid requests for higher gas, electricity and heating tariffs. Experts warn that costlier energy and fuel will pressure prices of goods and services.
why: Energy tariff changes feed into inflation and household spending, and they influence central bank and fiscal decisions in the economy.
